title: 第1363章 大虚妄破灭掌第1362章 冰渊剑的来历
content_zh:
铮！
刀剑交击的瞬间，一股无法形容的恐怖力量从剑身上传来，楚夏只觉得自己的双臂仿佛被一座太古神山正面撞击，虎口瞬间炸开，鲜血顺着剑柄滴落。
但他的身体依旧稳稳地站在原地，没有后退半步。
他的身后，那团白金色的光茧依旧在缓缓旋转，光茧中的薇丝帕还在融合。
他不能退。
肯塔乌的血红色眼眸中闪过一丝惊讶。
他刚才那一刀虽然看似随意，但实际上已经动用了天道化身的七成力量，配合极道皇的杀戮之力，就算是位面主级别的存在都未必能轻易接下。
但楚夏居然接住了，而且没有后退一步。
是冰渊剑。
那柄冰蓝色的长剑在碰撞的瞬间吸收了极道皇刀芒中的大部分杀戮之力，剑身上的冰霜在刀芒的冲击下不断炸开又不断凝聚，每一次生灭都会将刀芒的力量削弱一分。
而残存的刀芒冲击则被群星闪耀套装承受了下来，虽然依旧震裂了楚夏的虎口，但已经无法对他造成致命伤害。
“好剑。”肯塔乌由衷地赞叹了一声，但手上的动作却没有丝毫停顿。
极道皇在他手中化作了一道血红色的风暴，刀芒从四面八方同时斩向楚夏。
每一道刀芒都蕴含着足以斩杀九阶巅峰主宰者的恐怖力量，刀芒所过之处，空间被切得支离破碎，时间线被斩得七零八落，天道法则在刀芒面前如同纸糊的一般被轻易撕碎。
楚夏挥动冰渊剑，竭尽全力格挡着从四面八方涌来的刀芒。
铮铮铮铮铮！
刀剑交击的声音连成一片，密集得如同暴风骤雨。
楚夏的身上不断浮现出一道道深可见骨的刀伤，但群星闪耀套装的生命序列之力又在瞬间将这些伤口修复。鲜血刚刚喷出便被天道之力蒸干，骨骼刚刚碎裂便被不朽之力重新凝聚。
他整个人就像是一堵摇摇欲坠的堤坝，在肯塔乌这片狂风暴雨般的攻击中苦苦支撑。
但他始终没有倒下。

冰渊剑在他手中越挥越快，剑身上的冰蓝色光芒也越亮越耀眼。
楚夏发现，随着战斗的持续，他与冰渊剑之间的联系正在变得越来越紧密。
一开始他只是单纯地握着剑柄挥砍格挡，但渐渐地，冰剑仿佛变成了他身体的一部分——他的意念刚刚生出，剑便已经挥出；他的目光刚刚捕捉到刀芒的轨迹，剑锋便已经迎了上去。
这种奇妙的感觉让楚夏在肯塔乌狂风暴雨般的攻击中勉强稳住了阵脚。
肯塔乌也注意到了这一点。
他的眉头皱了起来，脸上的表情更加阴沉了几分。
冰渊剑与楚夏之间的契合度正在以肉眼可见的速度提升，而这意味着，冰渊剑是真的认可了楚夏。
如果再让这小子继续成长下去，说不定他真的能参悟冰渊剑的奥秘，获得那传说中足以知晓世界真相的力量。
不能留他了。
肯塔乌的眼眸中闪过一丝决然。
他忽然停下了攻势，身形向后飘退数百丈，重新回到天穹之上。
楚夏得以喘息，他剧烈地喘着粗气，浑身上下满是深可见骨的刀伤。
虽然群星闪耀套装在不断修复着他的身体，但天道渗透的持续侵蚀和极道皇刀芒中蕴含的杀戮之力都在阻挠着修复的速度。
他的脸色惨白如纸，握剑的手也在微微颤抖。
“小子。”肯塔乌的声音再次响起，语气中多了一丝罕见的郑重，“你是这数千亿年来，第一个能让老夫如此认真对待的对手。你的天赋、你的机缘、你的意志，都堪称完美，若是再给你几亿年的时间，或许你真的能成长到让老夫仰望的高度。”
他顿了顿，那双血红色的眼眸中闪过一丝惋惜：“可惜，你没有那个机会了。”
话音落下，肯塔乌缓缓抬起了左手。
他的左手干枯而瘦小，布满皱纹的皮肤紧紧包裹着纤细的指骨，看上去就像是一截枯木。
但当他将左手举过头顶时，整个虚妄大陆的天道法则都开始疯狂涌动。
无穷无尽的天道之力从四面八方汇聚而来，在肯塔乌的左手掌心中凝聚成一团暗红色的光球。

光球并不大，只有拳头大小，但其中蕴含的天道之力却恐怖到了极致——那是肯塔乌以虚妄之神的身份，直接调动虚妄大陆天道本源凝聚而成的至高杀招。
content_en:
Zheng!
The moment the swords clashed, an indescribable terrifying force came from the sword. Chu Xia felt as if her arms were being hit head-on by an ancient sacred mountain. The tiger's mouth exploded instantly, and blood dripped down the hilt of the sword.
But his body still stood firmly in place, without taking a step back.
Behind him, the white-gold cocoon of light was still slowly rotating, and Vespa in the cocoon was still merging.
He can't retreat.
Kentau's blood-red eyes flashed with surprise.
Although the sword strike he made just now seemed random, it actually used 70% of the power of the incarnation of Heavenly Dao. Coupled with the killing power of the Jidao Emperor, even a plane master-level existence may not be able to take it easily.
But Chu Xia actually caught it without taking a step back.
It's the Ice Abyss Sword.
The ice-blue long sword absorbed most of the killing power of the Jidao Emperor's sword light at the moment of collision. The ice on the sword continued to explode and condense under the impact of the sword light. Every birth and death would weaken the power of the sword light.
The remaining impact of the sword light was withstood by the Shining Stars Suit. Although it still cracked Chu Xia's tiger's mouth, it was no longer able to cause fatal damage to him.
"What a sword." Kentau admired sincerely, but the movement of his hand did not stop at all.
The Jidao Emperor turned into a blood-red storm in his hands, and the sword light slashed at Chu Xia from all directions at the same time.
Every blade of light contained enough terrifying power to kill the master of the ninth level peak. Wherever the blade of light passed, the space was cut into pieces, the timeline was chopped into pieces, and the laws of heaven were easily torn apart like paper in front of the sword.
Chu Xia waved the Ice Abyss Sword and tried her best to block the sword light coming from all directions.
Clang, clank, clank!
The sound of swords clashing was one continuous sound, as dense as a storm.
Chu Xia's body continued to have knife wounds that were deep enough to see the bones, but the power of the life sequence of the Shining Stars Suit repaired these wounds in an instant. The blood was evaporated by the power of heaven as soon as it spurted out, and the bones were reunited by the power of immortality as soon as they were broken.
His whole body was like a crumbling embankment, struggling to hold up under the violent storm of Kentau.
But he never fell.
The Ice Abyss Sword was swung faster and faster in his hand, and the ice-blue light on the sword became brighter and more dazzling.
Chu Xia discovered that as the battle continued, the connection between him and the Bingyuan Sword was becoming closer and closer.
At first, he simply held the hilt of the sword to slash and block, but gradually, the ice sword seemed to become a part of his body - as soon as his thoughts came out, the sword was already swung out; as soon as his eyes caught the trajectory of the sword's light, the sword's edge was already facing it.
This wonderful feeling allowed Chu Xia to barely hold his ground amidst Kentau's violent attacks.
Kentau noticed this too.
His brows furrowed, and the expression on his face became a little more gloomy.
The compatibility between Bingyuan Sword and Chu Xia is improving at a speed visible to the naked eye, which means that Bingyuan Sword really recognizes Chu Xia.
If this kid is allowed to continue to grow, maybe he can really understand the mystery of the Ice Abyss Sword and obtain the legendary power that is enough to know the truth of the world.
We can't keep him.
Kentau's eyes flashed with determination.
He suddenly stopped his offensive and floated back several hundred feet, returning to the sky again.
Chu Xia was able to breathe. He was breathing heavily, and his whole body was covered with knife wounds that were deep enough to see the bones.
Although the Shining Stars Suit is constantly repairing his body, the continuous erosion of the penetration of Heavenly Dao and the killing power contained in the light of the Jidao Emperor's sword are hindering the speed of repair.
His face was as pale as paper, and the hand holding the sword was trembling slightly.
"Boy." Kentau's voice sounded again, with a rare hint of solemnity in his tone, "You are the first person in hundreds of billions of years to make an old manAn opponent that my husband takes so seriously.你的天赋、你的机缘、你的意志，都堪称完美，若是再给你几亿年的时间，或许你真的能成长到让老夫仰望的高度。 "
他顿了顿，那双血红色的眼眸中闪过一丝惋惜：“可惜，你没有那个机会了。 "
After the words fell, Kentau slowly raised his left hand.
他的左手干枯而瘦小，布满皱纹的皮肤紧紧包裹着纤细的指骨，看上去就像是一截枯木。
但当他将左手举过头顶时，整个虚妄大陆的天道法则都开始疯狂涌动。
无穷无尽的天道之力从四面八方汇聚而来，在肯塔乌的左手掌心中凝聚成一团暗红色的光球。
光球并不大，只有拳头大小，但其中蕴含的天道之力却恐怖到了极致——那是肯塔乌以虚妄之神的身份，直接调动虚妄大陆天道本源凝聚而成的至高杀招。
